title: OSC 10/11 query replies leak into shell stdin in 0.45.0 (regression from #5105)
body:
## Issue description

OSC 10/11 query replies emitted by an application inside a pane are
delivered into that pane's stdin instead of being consumed by the
application that asked. In a cooked-mode shell (zsh, bash) the reply
shows up at the next prompt as if it were typed.

In practice p10k's instant prompt issues an OSC 11 at shell startup,
and the leaked bytes break `gh auth login`:

    could not prompt: unexpected escape sequence from terminal: ['\x1b' ']']

This is a regression from 0.44.1.

## Minimal reproduction

Any host terminal that answers OSC 11 (WezTerm, Alacritty, kitty). In
a zsh pane:

    printf '\e]11;?\e\\'

Next prompt:

    ~  ^[]11;rgb:0000/0000/0000^[\

## Other relevant information

I built 0.44.1 and 0.45.0 from source. 0.44.1 is fine — the reply
arrives in time to be consumed on the same line, and the next prompt
is clean. 0.45.0 reproduces.

The forward path (`zellij-server/src/host_query.rs`,
`Screen::handle_forwarded_reply_from_host` writing the reply to the
pane's pty) was introduced by 227142dd (#5105). Its body says "the
reply streaming back into the relevant pane" — fine for raw-mode TUIs
that parse OSC, but cooked-mode shells just read the bytes as input.

`zellij --version`: 0.45.0
`uname -av`: Darwin 25.5.0 arm64
Host terminal: WezTerm. Shell: zsh + p10k.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Friends - while I am not discounting anyone's experience, I'm going to need more to go on.

As is often the case with these things, I am not reproducing *any* of these scenarios. Setups are complex, particular and include many moving parts. They differ from machine to machine and under different circumstances. "This happens in fish", "this happens in gh cli" or "this happens in the terminal but not in Zellij" is unfortunately not something I can work with.

I'm going to need a report along the lines of "I am sending this sequence on STDOUT, expecting that response over STDIN and it comes fragmented" (checked that btw, it's not it), or "This program sends sequence X over STDOUT with a timeout of Y, and in situation Z Zellij replies too slow" (also checked that, it's not it). If the report includes one or more applications, in the vast majority of situations I will not be able to reproduce it.

Would love to get to the bottom of this, if it indeed is a Zellij issue. I am however going to need more legwork from those experiencing it.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Thanks Aram.

I managed to get a more controlled reproduction comparing 0.44.1 and 0.44.2.

Setup:
- Linux x86_64
- fish shell inside the Zellij pane
- outer capture done with script(1) using its timing log
- TERM=xterm-256color
- working directory: ~/zdash
- same pane command and same directory for both Zellij versions

The pane command wraps fish_prompt to print a unique PROMPT marker at the beginning of prompt rendering. The command under test prints a START marker, runs ls, then prints a DONE marker. I then measure the time in the outer PTY stream from DONE to the next PROMPT marker.

Result over 5 runs:

Zellij 0.44.1:
- DONE -> PROMPT: 0.0185s, 0.0172s, 0.0183s, 0.0165s, 0.0179s
- average: ~0.0177s
- captured host-query sequences: OSC 4 = 0, OSC 10 = 0, OSC 11 = 0, CSI ?996n = 0, CSI ?2031 = 0

Zellij 0.44.2:
- DONE -> PROMPT: 1.0228s, 1.0229s, 1.0249s, 1.0214s, 1.0229s
- average: ~1.0230s
- captured host-query sequences per run: OSC 4 = 256, OSC 10 = 1, OSC 11 = 3, CSI ?996n = 1, CSI ?2031 = 1

Looking at one 0.44.2 timing log between DONE and PROMPT, there are two ~500ms output gaps:

- 0.503791s
- 0.501712s

The corresponding 0.44.1 run has no such two 500ms gaps; the relevant post-DONE delay is about 18ms.

I also repeated a single-run check with osc8_hyperlinks false:
- Zellij 0.44.1: DONE -> PROMPT ~0.0189s
- Zellij 0.44.2: DONE -> PROMPT ~1.0240s
- OSC8 sequences in the 0.44.2 capture: 0
- the same host-query sequences were still present: 256 OSC 4 queries, OSC 10/11 queries, CSI ?996n, and CSI ?2031

So this does not look like an OSC8 issue. My current interpretation is narrower: in an outer PTY that does not answer these host terminal queries, 0.44.2 appears to delay/buffer the next prompt render by about two 500ms waits. 0.44.1 does not show this behavior under the same test.

comments.body:
[zellij_0.45_new.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27478667/zellij_0.45_new.log)

Here are the new logs. I had an AI analyze them and it pointed out the 
following — I can't verify this myself, but maybe it's useful:

Token 15 shows a TIMEOUT-CLOSE after 500ms with accumulated=0B, meaning 
Kitty never replied to the OSC 11 (DefaultBackground) query within the 
timeout window. Zellij then waited the full 500ms before releasing buffered 
output via cache-fallback. This seems to happen repeatedly per command.

Was this blocking/timeout behavior introduced in 0.44.2?
